executive_summary: Today's overarching theme is the profound destabilization caused by protracted institutional conflict and systemic vulnerability, as evidenced across both geopolitical discourse and global current events. The enduring friction highlighted in Foreign Affairs regarding the transatlantic alliance and persistent conflicts in Russia and Iran directly mirrors the institutional warfare examined by The Athletic between FIFA, UEFA, and modern sports governance. Concurrently, the breaking news alerts regarding mass border crossings in Spanish territory and fatal avalanches in Pakistan underscore the severe human costs of unmanaged systemic pressures. By connecting these complex diplomatic struggles with immediate humanitarian crises, the day's reporting demonstrates how fractured global systems continue to generate acute instability from the corridors of power to vulnerable frontiers.

newsletters.title: Spicy cucumbers with mint and peanuts

items.headline: Spicy cucumbers with mint, scallions and crushed peanuts
items.blurb: This salad is just the thing to wake up a muggy summer day. Crisp cucumbers and thin scallion slices are doused in a bright and bracing dressing that’s supercharged with lime juice, fish sauce, Thai and Fresno chiles and sesame oil. Mint, basil, cilantro and a shower of crushed peanuts lend a fresh, crunchy finish. Take it from this reader endorsement: “This was insanely delicious. The best cucumber salad I’ve ever made.”

items.headline: Steak Frites
items.blurb:
Few dishes conjure a Parisian bistro more readily than steak frites. And few recipe creators are better equipped to adapt it for a home kitchen than Dorie Greenspan, who’s lived between the United States and France for decades. Her version features a rib-eye topped with a pat of herb butter and is paired with thick, steak-cut frozen fries. Before you scoff at the frozen fries: “Call it a cheat, but they’re what lots of French home cooks use,” Dorie writes in the recipe headnote.
Ryan Liebe for The New York Times. Food Stylist: Anna Billingskog.
